Introduction

Lin Lin is a Taiwanese singer, dancer and rapper under HIM International Music and member of the Taiwanese girl group babyMINT. She is a former member of the girl group Cherry Bullet, with whom she debuted with on January 21, 2019 with the mini album "Let's Play Cherry Bullet" and it's title track "Q & A".
